```{r setup, eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE, results = 'hide', include = FALSE}
# --- Data paths ---
url_manifest                 <- "../data/manifest.txt"
url_preanalytical_conditions <- "../data/pre-analytical_conditions.txt"
url_hpv_type                 <- "../data/TM-2021-MSK-002_HPV_Typing_WES_WGS.txt"
url_clinical                 <- "../data/clinical.txt"
url_mutation_summary         <- "../data/mutation_summary.maf"
url_idx_metrics_ft           <- "../data/idx_metrics_ft.txt"

target_contigs <- c(
  "HPV-16" = "NC001526.4",
  "HPV-18" = "NC001357.1",
  "HPV-31" = "J04353.1",
  "HPV-33" = "M12732.1",
  "HPV-35" = "X74477.1"
)

FRAGMENT_LENGTH_THRESHOLD <- 37

scientific_10 <- function(x) {
  parse(text = gsub("+", "", gsub("e", " %.% 10^", scales::scientific_format()(x)), fixed = TRUE))
}

# --- Shared rpart control for classification tree CV ---
paramy <- rpart::rpart.control(
  minsplit     = 5,
  minbucket    = 2,
  maxdepth     = 5,
  maxcompete   = 1000,
  maxsurrogate = 100,
  usesurrogate = 2,
  cp           = -Inf,
  xval         = 100
)

# --- Helper: pivot per-patient per-timepoint data to wide abs/rel columns ---
make_wide <- function(df, value_col, prefix) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(patient_id_mskcc, timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(v = mean(.data[[value_col]] + 1e-5, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    reshape2::dcast(
      formula       = patient_id_mskcc ~ timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT,
      fun.aggregate = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      fill          = NaN,
      value.var     = "v"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(patient_id_mskcc, `Pre-treatment`, wk1, wk2, wk3) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      !!paste0("rel_", prefix, "_wk1") := wk1 / `Pre-treatment`,
      !!paste0("rel_", prefix, "_wk2") := wk2 / `Pre-treatment`,
      !!paste0("rel_", prefix, "_wk3") := wk3 / `Pre-treatment`
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      !!paste0("abs_", prefix, "_wk0") := `Pre-treatment`,
      !!paste0("abs_", prefix, "_wk1") := wk1,
      !!paste0("abs_", prefix, "_wk2") := wk2,
      !!paste0("abs_", prefix, "_wk3") := wk3
    )
}

# --- Helper: run univariate GLM (probit) for each variable against one outcome ---
run_glm <- function(smry_long, outcome_col) {
  uvars <- unique(smry_long$variable)
  vapply(uvars, function(v) {
    tryCatch({
      (smry_long %>%
        dplyr::filter(variable == v) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(value = log2(value)) %>%
        stats::glm(
          formula = as.formula(paste(outcome_col, "~ value")),
          data    = .,
          family  = binomial(link = "probit")
        ) %>%
        summary() %>%
        .[["coefficients"]])[2, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  }, numeric(1))
}

# --- Helper: run Wilcoxon test for each variable against one outcome ---
run_wilcox <- function(smry_long, outcome_col) {
  uvars <- unique(smry_long$variable)
  vapply(uvars, function(v) {
    tryCatch({
      smry_long %>%
        dplyr::filter(variable == v) %>%
        wilcox.test(
          formula = as.formula(paste("value ~", outcome_col)),
          data    = .,
          exact   = FALSE
        ) %>%
        .[["p.value"]]
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  }, numeric(1))
}

# --- Helper: 5-fold CV AUC (100 repeats) using classification tree ---
ClTree_5Cv_AUC <- function(data) {
  tidy_data <- tidyr::drop_na(data)
  roc <- replicate(100, {
    folds <- split(tidy_data, cut(sample(seq_len(nrow(tidy_data))), 5))
    fold_aucs <- vapply(seq_along(folds), function(i) {
      test  <- plyr::ldply(folds[i],  data.frame, .id = NULL)
      train <- plyr::ldply(folds[-i], data.frame, .id = NULL)
      fit   <- rpart(composite_end_point ~ ., data = train, method = "class", control = paramy)
      pred  <- predict(fit, newdata = test, type = "prob")
      tryCatch(
        pROC::roc(response = test$composite_end_point, predictor = pred[, "1"], quiet = TRUE)$auc %>%
          as.numeric(),
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
    }, numeric(1))
    mean(fold_aucs, na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  invisible(roc)
}

# --- Helper: 10-fold CV misclassification error (100 repeats) ---
ClTree_10Cv_MCE <- function(data) {
  tidy_data <- tidyr::drop_na(data)
  mce <- replicate(100, {
    folds <- split(tidy_data, cut(sample(seq_len(nrow(tidy_data))), 10))
    fold_mce <- vapply(seq_along(folds), function(i) {
      test  <- plyr::ldply(folds[i],  data.frame, .id = NULL)
      train <- plyr::ldply(folds[-i], data.frame, .id = NULL)
      fit   <- rpart(composite_end_point ~ ., data = train, method = "class", control = paramy)
      pred  <- predict(fit, newdata = test, type = "class")
      conf  <- table(test$composite_end_point, pred)
      1 - sum(diag(conf)) / sum(conf)
    }, numeric(1))
    mean(fold_mce, na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  invisible(100 * mce)
}

# --- Helper: run CV on a named list of column subsets from smry_ ---
run_cv_set <- function(smry_, col_sets, cv_fn, seed = 12345) {
  set.seed(seed)
  lapply(col_sets, function(cols) {
    data <- smry_ %>%
      dplyr::select(composite_end_point, all_of(cols)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(composite_end_point = factor(composite_end_point)) %>%
      tidyr::drop_na()
    result <- try(cv_fn(data = data))
    while (inherits(result, "try-error")) result <- try(cv_fn(data = data))
    result
  })
}

assay_levels <- c("cfDNA HPV\nReads", "ctDNA\nFraction", "MRI\nVolume", "ctDNA Fraction\n+ MRI Volume")

# --- Helper: shared box+jitter plot for cross-validation results ---
cv_boxplot <- function(results, y_lab, y_limits, sig_y1, sig_y2, p1, p2) {
  combined_median <- results %>%
    dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
    reshape2::melt() %>%
    dplyr::filter(variable == "ctDNA Fraction\n+ MRI Volume") %>%
    .[["value"]] %>%
    median()

  results %>%
    dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
    reshape2::melt() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = assay_levels, ordered = TRUE)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = variable, y = value)) +
    geom_boxplot(stat = "boxplot", outlier.shape = NA, color = "#fc8d62") +
    geom_jitter(
      stat     = "identity",
      position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2),
      shape    = 21, size = 2, fill = "white", alpha = 0.55, color = "#fc8d62"
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = combined_median, linetype = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits) +
    xlab("") +
    ylab(y_lab) +
    geom_signif(annotation = formatC(p1, digits = 1),
                y_position = sig_y1, xmin = 2.3, xmax = 4,
                tip_length = c(0.03, 0.03), color = "black") +
    geom_signif(annotation = formatC(p2, digits = 1),
                y_position = sig_y2, xmin = 3.3, xmax = 4,
                tip_length = c(0.03, 0.03), color = "black") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 20)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(r = 20)),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 10, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12)
    )
}

# --- Helper: half-violin + half-dotplot + signif for risk-group box plots ---
risk_group_plot <- function(df, var, y_expr, y_scale, y_lab, sig_y) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::filter(variable == var) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(composite_end_point = factor(composite_end_point, levels = c(0, 1), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = composite_end_point, y = !!y_expr, fill = composite_end_point)) +
    geom_half_dotplot(
      binaxis = "y", stackdir = "up", dotsize = 0.65,
      right = TRUE, method = "dotdensity", fill = "white"
    ) +
    geom_half_violin(
      stat = "half_ydensity", side = "l",
      trim = FALSE, scale = "count", color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_brewer(type = "qual", palette = 7) +
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = c(0, 1), labels = c("Low", "High")) +
    y_scale +
    xlab("Risk group") +
    ylab(y_lab) +
    geom_signif(
      stat        = "signif",
      comparisons = list(c("0", "1")),
      test        = "wilcox.test",
      test.args   = list(alternative = "two.sided", exact = FALSE),
      linewidth   = 0.55,
      textsize    = 4,
      color       = "grey25",
      vjust       = -0.5,
      y_position  = sig_y
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 20), size = 12),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(r = 20), size = 12),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12)
    ) +
    guides(color = "none", fill = "none")
}

# --- Helper: reformat variable names for the Gini importance plot ---
format_vip_labels <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      variables = gsub("abs_AF_",  "ctDNA Fraction (", variables, fixed = TRUE),
      variables = gsub("abs_HPV_", "cfDNA HPV Reads (", variables, fixed = TRUE),
      variables = gsub("abs_MRI_", "MRI Volume (",      variables, fixed = TRUE),
      variables = paste0(variables, ")"),
      variables = gsub("wk", "Week ", variables, fixed = TRUE),
      week      = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("Week 0", variables) ~ 0L,
        grepl("Week 1", variables) ~ 1L,
        grepl("Week 2", variables) ~ 2L,
        grepl("Week 3", variables) ~ 3L
      ),
      category = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("ctDNA", variables) ~ 1L,
        grepl("cfDNA", variables) ~ 2L,
        grepl("MRI",   variables) ~ 3L
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(week), desc(category)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(variables = factor(variables, levels = unique(variables), ordered = TRUE))
}
```

```{r load_shared_data, eval = TRUE, include = FALSE}

manifest_raw <- readr::read_tsv(
  url_manifest, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
) %>%
  readr::type_convert() %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(bam_file_name_hpv)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sample_uuid = paste0(sample_id_mskcc, "-", sample_id_invitae))

preanalytical_conditions <- readr::read_tsv(
  url_preanalytical_conditions, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
) %>%
  readr::type_convert()

hpv_smry <- readr::read_tsv(
  url_hpv_type, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
) %>%
  readr::type_convert() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    patient_id_mskcc = gsub("-T", "", patient_name, fixed = TRUE),
    patient_id_mskcc = gsub("155salv", "155", patient_id_mskcc, fixed = TRUE),
    hpv_type_wes     = gsub("HPV", "HPV-", hpv_type_wes, fixed = TRUE),
    hpv_type_wgs     = gsub("HPV", "HPV-", hpv_type_wgs, fixed = TRUE),
    hpv_type_wes_wgs = gsub("HPV", "HPV-", hpv_type_wes_wgs, fixed = TRUE),
    hpv_type_wes_wgs = dplyr::coalesce(hpv_type_wes_wgs, "Unknown")
  )

manifest <- manifest_raw %>%
  dplyr::left_join(preanalytical_conditions, by = "sample_id_mskcc") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    patient_id_mskcc = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(patient_id_mskcc) & sample_id_mskcc == "21-144-03654" ~ "CTMS-164",
      TRUE ~ patient_id_mskcc
    ),
    sample_name = paste0(sample_id_mskcc, "-", sample_id_invitae)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(hpv_smry, by = "patient_id_mskcc")

mutation_smry <- readr::read_tsv(
  url_mutation_summary, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
) %>%
  readr::type_convert()

clinical <- readr::read_tsv(
  url_clinical, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
) %>%
  readr::type_convert()

# --- Per-sample mutation AF summary ---
mut_af_smry <- mutation_smry %>%
  dplyr::filter(FILTER == "PASS") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Tumor_Sample_Barcode) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean_af = mean(t_maf), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::rename(sample_name = Tumor_Sample_Barcode)

# --- Index metrics: all timepoints, HPV panel type resolved ---
idx_metrics_ft <- readr::read_tsv(
  url_idx_metrics_ft, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
) %>%
  readr::type_convert() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_name     = SAMPLE_NAME,
    contig          = CHROMOSOME,
    aligned_reads   = ALIGNED_READS,
    fragment_length = FRAGMENT_LENGTH
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    dplyr::tibble(contig = target_contigs, chromosome = names(target_contigs)),
    by = "contig"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(fragment_length == FRAGMENT_LENGTH_THRESHOLD, !is.na(chromosome)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(manifest, by = "sample_name") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    dplyr::select(clinical, patient_id_mskcc, hpv_type_panel),
    by = "patient_id_mskcc"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    hpv_type_panel         = gsub("HPV", "HPV-", hpv_type_panel, fixed = TRUE),
    hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel = dplyr::case_when(
      hpv_type_wes_wgs == "Unknown" ~ hpv_type_panel,
      TRUE ~ hpv_type_wes_wgs
    ),
    hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel = dplyr::coalesce(hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel, "Unknown")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(chromosome == hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(mut_af_smry, by = "sample_name") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT = floor(timepoint_days_since_start_of_RT / 7),
    timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT = dplyr::case_when(
      timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT < 0 ~ "Pre-treatment",
      TRUE ~ paste0("wk", timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT)
    )
  )

# --- Shared wide summary: AF, HPV, MRI joined with outcome ---
# Note: MRI uses one-week imaging offset (wk0/1/2/3 ← wk0/2/3/4)
smry_wide <- make_wide(idx_metrics_ft, "mean_af", "AF") %>%
  dplyr::full_join(
    make_wide(dplyr::filter(idx_metrics_ft, hpv_type_wes_wgs == "HPV-16"), "aligned_reads", "HPV"),
    by = "patient_id_mskcc"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(clinical, by = "patient_id_mskcc") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    patient_id_mskcc,
    composite_end_point, neck_dissection_yes_no, hypoxia_resolution,
    abs_AF_wk0,  abs_AF_wk1,  abs_AF_wk2,  abs_AF_wk3,
    rel_AF_wk1,  rel_AF_wk2,  rel_AF_wk3,
    abs_HPV_wk0, abs_HPV_wk1, abs_HPV_wk2, abs_HPV_wk3,
    rel_HPV_wk1, rel_HPV_wk2, rel_HPV_wk3,
    abs_MRI_wk0 = MRI_rawdata_wk0,
    abs_MRI_wk1 = MRI_rawdata_wk2,
    abs_MRI_wk2 = MRI_rawdata_wk3,
    abs_MRI_wk3 = MRI_rawdata_wk4
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    rel_MRI_wk1         = abs_MRI_wk1 / abs_MRI_wk0,
    rel_MRI_wk2         = abs_MRI_wk2 / abs_MRI_wk0,
    rel_MRI_wk3         = abs_MRI_wk3 / abs_MRI_wk0,
    composite_end_point = dplyr::if_else(composite_end_point, 1L, 0L),
    neck_dissection_yes_no = dplyr::case_when(
      neck_dissection_yes_no == "yes" ~ "1",
      neck_dissection_yes_no == "no"  ~ "0"
    ),
    hypoxia_resolution = dplyr::case_when(
      hypoxia_resolution == "persistent" ~ "1",
      hypoxia_resolution == "resolved"   ~ "0"
    )
  ) %>%
  readr::type_convert()
```

```{r build_plots_5bc, eval = TRUE, include = FALSE}
# --- Long format for GLM / Wilcoxon ---
smry_long <- smry_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(-patient_id_mskcc) %>%
  reshape2::melt(
    id.vars = c("composite_end_point", "neck_dissection_yes_no", "hypoxia_resolution")
  ) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()

uvars <- unique(smry_long$variable)

p1 <- run_glm(smry_long,    "composite_end_point")
p2 <- run_glm(smry_long,    "neck_dissection_yes_no")
p3 <- run_glm(smry_long,    "hypoxia_resolution")
q1 <- run_wilcox(smry_long, "composite_end_point")
q2 <- run_wilcox(smry_long, "neck_dissection_yes_no")
q3 <- run_wilcox(smry_long, "hypoxia_resolution")

baseline_rows <- dplyr::tibble(
  variables              = rep(c("rel_AF_wk0", "rel_MRI_wk0", "rel_HPV_wk0"), 2),
  `De-escalation failure` = 1,
  `PET response`          = 1,
  `Risk group`            = 1,
  Method                  = rep(c("log", "u"), each = 3)
)

res_ <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dplyr::tibble(
    variables              = uvars,
    `De-escalation failure` = p2,
    `PET response`          = p3,
    `Risk group`            = p1,
    Method                  = "log"
  ),
  dplyr::tibble(
    variables              = uvars,
    `De-escalation failure` = q2,
    `PET response`          = q3,
    `Risk group`            = q1,
    Method                  = "u"
  ),
  baseline_rows
)

# --- F5c: univariate association heatmap ---
plot_hm <- res_ %>%
  dplyr::filter(Method == "log") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Method) %>%
  reshape2::melt() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    week  = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("wk0", variables, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Pre-treat\n-ment",
      grepl("wk1", variables, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Week 1",
      grepl("wk2", variables, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Week 2",
      grepl("wk3", variables, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Week 3"
    ),
    assay = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("AF",  variables, fixed = TRUE) ~ "PCM",
      grepl("HPV", variables, fixed = TRUE) ~ "HPV",
      grepl("MRI", variables, fixed = TRUE) ~ "MRI"
    ),
    mode  = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("rel", variables, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Relative",
      grepl("abs", variables, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Absolute"
    ),
    mode      = factor(mode,     levels = c("Absolute", "Relative"), ordered = TRUE),
    assay     = factor(assay,    levels = c("HPV", "PCM", "MRI"),    ordered = TRUE),
    variable  = factor(variable, levels = c("Risk group", "PET response", "De-escalation failure"), ordered = TRUE),
    log_value = dplyr::case_when(
      week == "Pre-treat\n-ment" & mode == "Relative" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ -log10(value)
    ),
    value = dplyr::case_when(
      week == "Pre-treat\n-ment" & mode == "Relative" ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ value
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-variables) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = variable, fill = log_value, label = signif(value, 2))) +
  geom_tile(stat = "identity", color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(color = "white", size = 2) +
  scale_fill_viridis(breaks = seq(0, 3, by = 0.5)) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x     = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 20), size = 12),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(r = 20), size = 12),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 10, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  facet_grid(mode ~ assay) +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title = expression(-Log[10](q))))
```

```{r build_plot_5d, eval = TRUE, include = FALSE}

# Data for classification tree CV: drop-na on composite endpoint + AF + MRI
idx_metrics_ft <- readr::read_tsv(file = url_idx_metrics_ft, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) %>%
  readr::type_convert() %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_name = SAMPLE_NAME, contig = CHROMOSOME, aligned_reads = ALIGNED_READS, fragment_length = FRAGMENT_LENGTH) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    dplyr::tibble(
      contig = target_contigs,
      chromosome = names(target_contigs)
    ),
    by = "contig") %>%
  dplyr::filter(fragment_length == FRAGMENT_LENGTH_THRESHOLD) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(chromosome)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(manifest, by = "sample_name") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    clinical %>%
    dplyr::select(patient_id_mskcc, hpv_type_panel),
    by = "patient_id_mskcc"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(hpv_type_panel = gsub(pattern = "HPV", replacement = "HPV-", x = hpv_type_panel, fixed = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel = case_when(
      hpv_type_wes_wgs == "Unknown" ~ hpv_type_panel,
      TRUE ~ hpv_type_wes_wgs
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel = case_when(
      is.na(hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel) ~ "Unknown",
      TRUE ~ hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(chromosome == hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    mutation_smry %>%
    dplyr::filter(FILTER == "PASS") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, .drop = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(mean_af = mean(t_maf)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::rename(sample_name = Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
    by = "sample_name"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT = floor(timepoint_days_since_start_of_RT/7)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT = case_when(
      timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT < 0 ~ "Pre-treatment",
      TRUE ~ paste0("wk", timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT)
    )
  )

smry_cv <- idx_metrics_ft %>%
  dplyr::filter(hpv_type_wes_wgs == "HPV-16") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(patient_id_mskcc, timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT, .drop = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean_af = 100*mean(mean_af+1e-5, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  reshape2::dcast(
      formula = patient_id_mskcc ~ timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT,
      fun.aggregate = function(x) { mean(x, na.rm=TRUE) },
      fill = NaN,
      value.var = "mean_af"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(patient_id_mskcc, `Pre-treatment`, wk1, wk2, wk3) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    rel_AF_wk1 = wk1/`Pre-treatment`,
    rel_AF_wk2 = wk2/`Pre-treatment`,
    rel_AF_wk3 = wk3/`Pre-treatment`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    abs_AF_wk0 = `Pre-treatment`,
    abs_AF_wk1 = wk1,
    abs_AF_wk2 = wk2,
    abs_AF_wk3 = wk3
  ) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(
    idx_metrics_ft %>%
    dplyr::filter(hpv_type_wes_wgs == "HPV-16") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(patient_id_mskcc, timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT, .drop = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(aligned_reads = mean(aligned_reads)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    reshape2::dcast(
        formula = patient_id_mskcc ~ timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT,
        fun.aggregate = function(x) { mean(x, na.rm=TRUE) }, fill = NaN, value.var = "aligned_reads"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(patient_id_mskcc, `Pre-treatment`, wk1, wk2, wk3) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      rel_HPV_wk1 = wk1/`Pre-treatment`,
      rel_HPV_wk2 = wk2/`Pre-treatment`,
      rel_HPV_wk3 = wk3/`Pre-treatment`
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      abs_HPV_wk0 = `Pre-treatment`,
      abs_HPV_wk1 = wk1,
      abs_HPV_wk2 = wk2,
      abs_HPV_wk3 = wk3
    ),
    by = "patient_id_mskcc"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(clinical, by = "patient_id_mskcc") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    patient_id_mskcc,
    composite_end_point,
    abs_AF_wk0, abs_AF_wk1, abs_AF_wk2, abs_AF_wk3,
    rel_AF_wk1, rel_AF_wk2, rel_AF_wk3,
    abs_HPV_wk0, abs_HPV_wk1, abs_HPV_wk2, abs_HPV_wk3,
    rel_HPV_wk1, rel_HPV_wk2, rel_HPV_wk3,
    abs_MRI_wk0 = MRI_rawdata_wk0,
    abs_MRI_wk1 = MRI_rawdata_wk2,
    abs_MRI_wk2 = MRI_rawdata_wk3,
    abs_MRI_wk3 = MRI_rawdata_wk4
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    rel_MRI_wk1 = abs_MRI_wk1/abs_MRI_wk0,
    rel_MRI_wk2 = abs_MRI_wk2/abs_MRI_wk0,
    rel_MRI_wk3 = abs_MRI_wk1/abs_MRI_wk0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(composite_end_point = case_when(
      composite_end_point ~ 1,
      !composite_end_point ~ 0
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(composite_end_point, contains("AF"), contains("MRI"))
			
col_sets <- list(
  "cfDNA HPV\nReads"           	 = c("abs_HPV_wk0", "abs_HPV_wk1", "abs_HPV_wk2"),
  "ctDNA\nFraction"            	 = c("abs_AF_wk0",  "abs_AF_wk1",  "abs_AF_wk2"),
  "MRI\nVolume"                	 = c("abs_MRI_wk0", "abs_MRI_wk1", "abs_MRI_wk2"),
  "ctDNA Fraction\n+ MRI Volume" = c("abs_AF_wk0", "abs_AF_wk1", "abs_AF_wk2",
                                     "abs_MRI_wk0", "abs_MRI_wk1", "abs_MRI_wk2")
)

Test_Error <- run_cv_set(smry_cv, col_sets, ClTree_10Cv_MCE)

p_mce_1 <- wilcox.test(
  x = Test_Error[["ctDNA Fraction\n+ MRI Volume"]],
  y = Test_Error[["ctDNA\nFraction"]],
  alternative = "two.sided"
)$p.value

p_mce_2 <- wilcox.test(
  x = Test_Error[["ctDNA Fraction\n+ MRI Volume"]],
  y = Test_Error[["MRI\nVolume"]],
  alternative = "two.sided"
)$p.value

plot_mce <- cv_boxplot(
  results  = Test_Error,
  y_lab    = "10-Fold Misclass-\nification Error (%)",
  y_limits = c(0, 100),
  sig_y1   = 85,
  sig_y2   = 75,
  p1       = p_mce_1,
  p2       = p_mce_2
)
```

```{r build_plot_5e, eval = TRUE, include = FALSE}

Test_Auc <- run_cv_set(smry_cv, col_sets, ClTree_5Cv_AUC)

p_auc_1 <- wilcox.test(
  x = Test_Auc[["ctDNA Fraction\n+ MRI Volume"]],
  y = Test_Auc[["ctDNA\nFraction"]],
  alternative = "two.sided"
)$p.value

p_auc_2 <- wilcox.test(
  x = Test_Auc[["ctDNA Fraction\n+ MRI Volume"]],
  y = Test_Auc[["MRI\nVolume"]],
  alternative = "two.sided"
)$p.value

plot_auc <- cv_boxplot(
  results  = Test_Auc,
  y_lab    = "5-Fold Cross-\nvalidated AUC",
  y_limits = c(0, 1.5),
  sig_y1   = 0.85 * 1.5,
  sig_y2   = 0.75 * 1.5,
  p1       = p_auc_1,
  p2       = p_auc_2
)
```

```{r build_plot_5g, eval = TRUE, include = FALSE}

# Random forest variable importance on absolute features (HPV-16 patients only,
# using hpv_type_wes_wgs for consistency with the shared idx_metrics_ft)
rf_data <- smry_wide %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(composite_end_point)) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    composite_end_point,
    abs_AF_wk0,  abs_AF_wk1,  abs_AF_wk2,
    abs_HPV_wk0, abs_HPV_wk1, abs_HPV_wk2,
    abs_MRI_wk0, abs_MRI_wk1, abs_MRI_wk2
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(composite_end_point = factor(composite_end_point)) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()

set.seed(1234567)
rf <- randomForest(
  formula   = composite_end_point ~ .,
  data      = rf_data,
  ntree     = 1000,
  nodesize  = 1,
  maxnodes  = 10,
  importance = TRUE,
  proximity  = TRUE
)

vip <- importance(rf) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("variables") %>%
  format_vip_labels()

# Null distribution: permute labels 100 times
null_vip <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(100), function(i) {
  perm_data <- rf_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(composite_end_point = sample(composite_end_point, nrow(.), replace = TRUE))
  null_rf <- randomForest(
    formula   = composite_end_point ~ .,
    data      = perm_data,
    ntree     = 1000,
    nodesize  = 1,
    maxnodes  = 10,
    importance = TRUE,
    proximity  = TRUE
  )
  importance(null_rf) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("variables")
})) %>%
  format_vip_labels()

plot_gini <- null_vip %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x     = MeanDecreaseGini,
    y     = variables,
    fill  = factor(week),
    color = factor(week)
  )) +
  geom_density_ridges(stat = "density_ridges", alpha = 0.45, bandwidth = 0.05, scale = 1.25) +
  geom_segment(
    data    = vip,
    mapping = aes(
      x = MeanDecreaseGini, xend = MeanDecreaseGini,
      y = as.numeric(variables), yend = as.numeric(variables) + 0.5
    ),
    color       = "black",
    linewidth   = 0.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data    = vip,
    mapping = aes(
      x    = MeanDecreaseGini,
      y    = as.numeric(variables) + 0.5,
      fill = factor(week)
    ),
    color       = "black",
    shape       = 21,
    size        = 2,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(type = "qual", palette = 7) +
  scale_color_brewer(type = "qual", palette = 7) +
  xlab("\nVariable Importance\n\n") +
  ylab("") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x  = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y  = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 1),
    axis.line.y   = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y  = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(fill = "none", color = "none")
```
